# WY LEAKS [italic]Internal paper of the Company, posted without its permission.[/italic]
[color=#FF3B30][bold]:: NEW DROP :: 3 DOCUMENTS :: VERIFIED ::[/bold][/color]
## WHO WE ARE Nobody. Clerks, comms techs, a records officer who stopped sleeping. We are not the CLF, not a union and not a rival firm, and we take no money from any of them. We work inside Weyland-Yutani, or we did, and we read the mail that crosses our desks.
## HOW TO READ A DROP - Black bars like [color=#3A3A36]##########[/color] are the Company's own. The paper reached us that way. - Notes in [color=#6FA8FF]this colour[/color] are ours. Everything else is the original text, retyped from hard copy so the print codes cannot be traced back to the machine. - Reference numbers are real. If a liaison tells you a reference does not exist, ask how they know the format.
## CURRENT DROP - [netlink="DOC 01 // Specimen acquisition priority" link="wyleaks.deep/specimens"] - [netlink="DOC 02 // Personnel valuation schedule" link="wyleaks.deep/expendable"] - [netlink="DOC 03 // Procedure IC-7, the quiet site" link="wyleaks.deep/quietsite"]
## RULES FOR READERS - Do not print anything from this site on a Company terminal. - Do not say the words list B, Class Black or quiet site near a liaison. They are trained to listen for them. - If your colony's atmosphere processor fails next week, you heard it here first.
## ELSEWHERE IN THE DARK The [netlink="Colony Herald" link="herald.colony.news"] will not run this. Ask them who signs their power bill. People who walked out of the Company sometimes surface at [netlink="defector.deep" link="defector.deep"], and the names the Company stopped counting turn up at [netlink="missing.deep" link="missing.deep"].
[color=#6FA8FF][italic]Mirror often. This address has been burned twice.[/italic][/color]
